name: Manifest courier
design: Small lean adult female with warm ochre mottled hide, narrow domed head, fine four mandibles, long thin dreadlocks partly tied into a rear loop. Short charcoal tunic, dark slate capelet over one shoulder, single long crossbody dispatch satchel with bronze clasp, light wrapped calves. Carries two narrow sealed message tubes in right hand, left adjusting satchel strap; one foot naturally ahead.
